content.short: Rip.xyz is a Hyperliquid vault platform issuing tokenized yield positions such as rHYPE.
content.description: Rip.xyz runs tokenized vault strategies on HyperEVM and issues the positions as transferable tokens. Its flagship Hypurr Vault is an auto-managed NFT index token giving diversified exposure to the Hypurr NFT ecosystem, taking WHYPE deposits and minting rHYPURR. Vault assets are held in MPC wallets with multi-signature requirements, managed jointly by contracts and the operating team.
content.meta: Vault positions issued as tokens, so they can be used as collateral elsewhere.
